commands.review_summary:
The PR updates the shared media Content-Length parser to accept comma-separated repeated values only when they match, and adds parser plus media fetch regression coverage.

PR surface: Source +12, Tests +68. Total +80 across 3 files.

Reproducibility: yes. Source shows current main and v2026.6.11 reject `5, 5`, and a Node Headers probe shows repeated Content-Length values can reach the parser as comma-joined strings.

target.title: fix(media): accept repeated content-length when values match
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where media and plugin paths that rely on shared Content-Length parsing could reject otherwise valid responses when response headers expose repeated matching Content-Length values as a comma-joined header value.

## Why This Change Was Made

The shared media parser now parses each comma-separated Content-Length member with the existing digit and safe-integer checks, then accepts the header only when every parsed value agrees. Malformed, unsafe, empty, or conflicting values still fail before body reads, so callers keep their existing byte-cap decisions in one owner-local helper.

## User Impact

Users and plugin/channel developers are less likely to see valid media, auth, or download responses fail solely because an upstream server or proxy repeated an identical Content-Length header. Conflicting or malformed headers are still rejected.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: at current head `3b943a1294cc06c3432ef146022201338540ecb2`, the media fetch caller path accepts a response whose `Content-Length` value is `5, 5`, reads the 5-byte body, and rejects a conflicting `5, 6` value before body handling.
- Media caller-path proof: `node --import tsx --input-type=module` with `readRemoteMediaBuffer` from `src/media/fetch.ts` and fetch-compatible responses passed with this terminal output:

  ```text
  ok repeated matching content-length -> bytes=5 text=hello
  bad conflicting content-length -> MediaFetchError: Failed to fetch media from https://example.com/file.bin: invalid content-length header: 5, 6
  ```

- Focused regression tests: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/media-core/src/content-length.test.ts src/media/fetch.test.ts` passed: 2 Vitest shards, 44 tests.
- Committed diff hygiene: `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` passed.
- Review proof: `python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode branch --base upstream/main` passed with `autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported`.
- Scope checked: `git diff --name-only upstream/main...HEAD` contains only `packages/media-core/src/content-length.ts`, `packages/media-core/src/content-length.test.ts`, and `src/media/fetch.test.ts`.
